Everything is in place. No extension hooks to run. Implementation is complete and validated.

## ✅ Implementation complete — Bookmark Manager

All **15 phases / 56 tasks** are implemented, marked `[x]` in `tasks.md`, and validated. This cycle delivered **all 12 approved user stories**, not just the MVP, as you requested.

### What was built
A single-user, browser-based bookmark manager (Node + Express, vanilla-JS SPA, local SQLite), serving on `0.0.0.0:4000`:

| Story | Delivered & verified |
|---|---|
| US1 Save + auto-metadata | title/description/icon/preview fetched; editable before & after; invalid URLs → 422 |
| US2 No duplicates | re-saving a variant (host case / trailing slash / tracking params) opens the existing bookmark |
| US3 Browse/sort/open | list shows title/description/tags/icon; sort by date/title; opens original; empty state |
| US4 Search | case-insensitive; `#tag`; quoted phrases; **implicit AND**; **AND/OR/NOT literal only when quoted**; precedence; malformed → 400 |
| US5 Rich edit + notes | edit all fields; sanitised formatted notes (scripts stripped); tag suggestions; edit-to-collide blocked |
| US6 Read-later | ordinary by default; unread only when chosen; dedicated unread view |
| US7 Archive/delete | archive hides from list+search, restorable; delete needs confirmation |
| US8 Bulk actions | selection **or** "all matching"; tag add/remove **as deltas** (other tags preserved); partial-failure reporting |
| US9 Saved searches | named query + included/excluded tags; apply/rename/delete |
| US10 Import/export | Netscape format, titles/tags/dates preserved; dedup on import; invalid file → 422 |
| US11 Preservation | **self-contained HTML** (scripts stripped) via Chromium; **PDFs kept as PDF**; optional Internet Archive with graceful failure |
| US12 Preferences | default sort, items per view, text size — persisted and applied |

### Testing (`npm test` → exit 0)
- **23 unit** tests (search grammar, normalisation, metadata, Netscape)
- **13 DB-integration** tests (CRUD, duplicates, archive, bulk-tag deltas, saved searches)
- **2 Playwright smoke** tests (loads + harness-ready; save→list)

### Notable engineering decisions (recorded in the plan/research docs)
- **Storage switched from `better-sqlite3` to Node's built-in `node:sqlite`.** The native addon crashed at startup ~80% of the time on this Node 24 build; the built-in module is API-compatible for our use and starts **5/5 reliably**. This is an internal-only change — no spec or behaviour impact.

### Ready for review
- `.harness/app.json` declares `npm start` on port 4000; the port is free so the broker will start a fresh instance (showing the friendly empty state, `data-harness-ready`).
- Reference screenshot saved at `prototypes/bookmark-manager-main.png`.

The application is ready for your acceptance at `http://maker:4000`. You can save a URL live and exercise search, tags, read-later, archive, bulk actions, saved searches, import/export, and page preservation.
